description.narrative:
Scalling-Up is a development initiative aimed at contributing to the resilience of rural populations in the face of food insecurityand the effects of climate change. Therefore, the first step will be to promote access to land by young people and women vulnerableto food insecurity. This will stimulate the need to secure land for the benefit of the target people.
Ranked 186th among the 189 countries with a multidimensional poverty index, Chad is experiencing emerging land (tenure) crises intrinsically linked to the country's other crises (security, political, social, economic, etc.). As problems of secure access to land become increasingly difficult,land conflicts are also becoming more severe, with a great sense of land insecurity for most of the rural, and urban and peri-urbanpopulation. In Chad, between 85% and 90% of court cases are related to land disputes at various levels. Land conflicts are very often at the root of the deadly inter and intra-community clashes which are very frequent in the country. The livelihoods of the most vulnerable groups are negatively impacted due to: (i) land speculation and land grabbing carried out with total impunity; (ii) increased pressures on land capital due to population pressure (in some localities); (iii) climate change and humanitarian crises (refugees and internally displaced persons).
Project Bahr Linia. Aimed at developing peri-urban agriculture by improving access to water and securing agricultural land, the project Bahr Linia funded by the French Development cooperation agency (AfD), has been operating since 2016 in the area. It reflects a promise made by the late President of the Republic, Field Marshal Idriss Déby Itno. This demonstrates the interest shown by the senior Chadian authorities in issues relating to food self-sufficiency. Regarding land tenure security aspects, it should be noted that the Bahar Linia project has already developed and implemented a pilot strategy for rural land management that guarantees valorisation of agricultural land that is part of the irrigated perimeter and stabilizes local populationsby securing the various forms of rights applying in this area. It was also expected that the strategy put in place could have ultimately contributed to the adoption of land policies capable of engaging the responsibility of users in the management and conservation of land. AfD used the experience developed in other countries on ‘rural land plans’ to develop the operational strategy of the Bahr Linia project. These models are aimed at clarifying the land situation in the area, defining distribution and allocation of land resources by the actors themselves within an overall view and create the conditions for sustainable land tenure security, anchored inlocal governance systems and compatible with regulatory frameworks, by contributing to the establishment of a dialogue, local tools, fora, and mechanisms for resolving conflicts between the different actors.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Intermón is since 1997 a member of the international Oxfam confederation, sharing values and a strategic plan to achieve greater global impact. Intermón Oxfam fights, with and for disadvantaged populations and as part of a broad global movement, with the aim of eradicating injustice and poverty, and to ensure that all human beings can fully exercise their rights and enjoy a dignified life. Mission, Vision and Values are the components of Oxfam Intermón identity and guide its steps as an organisation and the ideal with which Oxfam Intermón wants to live in order to obtain a fairer world with greater solidarity.
